entries.0531583359e2daa2: HACHI-BAN CO.,LTD. traces its origins to a ramen shop opened by its founder in Kaga, Ishikawa Prefecture, in 1967, and was established in 1971 as Hachiban Food Service Co., Ltd. Consolidated headcount as of March 20, 2026 was 174 employees.
entries.0934a05926d0bb5b: The company combines in-house chain store management as a food service business and supply chain management as a food manufacturing and wholesale business, and has a structure in which noodles, gyoza and sauces are produced at its head office factory and central kitchen and supplied to a chain of 125 stores in Japan and 178 overseas. Overseas, the group handles everything from import and export of ingredients by a consolidated subsidiary in Thailand to the manufacture and sale of soup and extracts by an affiliated company.
